findings.message: This PR adds the IBM Db2 provider, and the only change here is the datamodel-codegen banner (`version: 0.73.0` -> `0.74.0`) with no Execution API OpenAPI schema change anywhere in the diff to justify a regeneration. Drop `_generated.py` from this PR and let it be regenerated by whichever PR actually changes the Execution API schema, so the generated file stays traceable to its source of truth.

`mock_dialect = MagicMock()` stands in for `Db2Dialect` - it is patched onto `hook.dialect` and the test then asserts `mock_dialect.get_column_names.assert_called_once_with("TEST_TABLE", "MY_SCHEMA")`. A bare mock accepts that call no matter what the real signature becomes, so the delegation test would keep passing if `Db2Dialect.get_column_names` changed its parameters. Spec it: `MagicMock(spec=Db2Dialect)` or `create_autospec(Db2Dialect, instance=True)`.
